lines.content: - `grep`-swept the whole `src/` tree for stray references to every deleted module — found none (only explanatory comments in the new Astro components mentioning what they replaced, which is intentional documentation, not a broken import).

- **Not done**: actually deploying to a Cloudflare Pages preview, merging the PR, or marking the branch's own local `master` reference stale. Holding here for explicit user direction — deploying/merging are the kind of shared, harder-to-reverse actions that warrant a check-in first, unlike the local branch work done so far.

- Status: **all 10 planned phases complete.** Remaining before this can actually ship: push, mark PR ready for review (currently draft), get a Cloudflare Pages preview deploy, do a final manual pass on the live preview URL, then merge.

- **Taskfile follow-up (same session)**: user noticed root `Taskfile.yml` never included `teeline-web/Taskfile.yml` (only `teeline-qt` was wired via `includes:`) and asked for `task web:serve` to mirror `task api:serve`. Fixed: added `web:` to root `includes:`, added a `serve` task (alias for `dev`) in `teeline-web/Taskfile.yml`. Verified `task web:serve` boots the dev server correctly (one transient failure reproducing a stop→immediate-restart race with the lock file, not a real bug — retried clean).
- **SHIPPED — merged and deployed to production.** User tested locally (`task web:serve`: main page, solver, and explainers all confirmed working) and asked to undraft the PR and release.
- Marked PR #358 ready for review (`gh pr ready`).

- Confirmed no branch protection on `master` (`gh api .../branches/master/protection` → 404) — nothing blocking merge despite `mergeStateStatus: UNSTABLE` (caused only by the pre-existing, non-blocking `codecov/project` check).

- Re-ran CI after the Taskfile commit, waited for green (`ci` job passed in 5m35s), then squash-merged (`gh pr merge --squash`) — matches this repo's established one-commit-per-PR convention. Merged as `33875d4`.
- `deploy-web.yml` auto-triggered on the push to `master` and completed in 51s.

- **Verified live production end-to-end**: `https://tspsolver.com/` and `/algorithms/sa/`, `/algorithms/pso/explainer/`, `/blog/`, `/rss.xml`, `/sitemap-index.xml` all return 200. Ran the same Playwright solve-flow check against the live site (not just local builds): berlin52 → 2-opt → real result `9368.3` (matches the local/staging runs), WASM version `teeline-solver 0.2.1` loaded correctly, zero console errors.
- Local repo synced: `master` fast-forwarded (107 files, +5215/-3717), local feature branch deleted (remote was auto-deleted by GitHub on merge).
- **Task complete.** All acceptance criteria met and verified on live production. Setting status to `done`.
None. Ready for the user to decide on push/PR-ready/preview-deploy next steps.

solve flow works (berlin52 -> 2-opt -> 9368.3), zero console errors.
Task complete, status: done.
